contract.name: Select
contract.summary: Native select control for single-value choice. Framework-agnostic CSS with native HTML reference markup.
contract.maturity: implemented; framework-agnostic CSS + native HTML; thin React adapter

component: Render a native <select> with the supplied options.
Apply only select.* component tokens for colour, geometry and typography.
Expose a native disabled state that removes the control from interaction and tab order.
Render a visible focus indicator for keyboard focus.
Remain presentational: it does not decide business rules or validate forms.
application: Choose the options and write the label.
Handle change events and form submission.
Use the native disabled attribute only when the control is genuinely unavailable.
Validate forms and move focus to the first invalid field.
Ensure a surrounding container does not clip the focus ring.

intended: Choosing one value from a known set of options (account type, currency, country).
Form fields where a native select is appropriate.

inappropriate.reason: This contract is single-value native <select> only.
inappropriate.alternative: Use a future multi-select or combobox component.

structure: Label associated with the select via for/id.
Optional helper or error message referenced by aria-describedby.

production.notes: Must be non-empty. The label is the accessible name.

codeOnlyProperties.description: Maps to the native disabled attribute.
codeOnlyProperties.notes: Do not use disabled as a validation strategy.

codeOnlyProperties.description: When provided, sets aria-invalid and shows the error message.
codeOnlyProperties.notes: The application owns the error copy.

codeOnlyProperties.description: Helper text shown when there is no error.

notes: Error state combines visible border with aria-invalid and text.
Helper and error text are referenced with aria-describedby.
Native disabled removes the control from interaction and tab order.
:focus-visible keyboard focus is never removed without a visible indicator.
